documents.text: I can't generate or host a downloadable `.zip` file directly — I don't have file-creation or download capabilities. But here's a complete, copy-paste-ready problem set you can save as a `.txt` or paste into Word/Google Docs and zip yourself. Answer key is at the end.---# BUSINESS COMPUTATION PROBLEM SET## A. ACCOUNTING PROBLEMS**A1. Trial Balance / Owner's Equity**A sole proprietor's ledger shows: Cash ₱50,000; Accounts Receivable ₱30,000; Supplies ₱5,000; Equipment ₱100,000; Accumulated Depreciation ₱20,000; Accounts Payable ₱15,000; Notes Payable ₱40,000. Compute total assets, total liabilities, and owner's equity.**A2. Depreciation Methods**Equipment costs ₱120,000, has a salvage value of ₱20,000 and a 5-year life. Compute (a) annual straight-line depreciation, and (b) double-declining-balance depreciation for Years 1 and 2.**A3. Accrual Adjustments**At year-end, the following are unrecorded: revenue earned but not yet billed ₱8,000; wages accrued ₱3,000; expired prepaid insurance ₱1,200. What is the net effect on net income?## B. FINANCE PROBLEMS**B1. Present Value**What is the present value of ₱50,000 to be received in 5 years if the discount rate is 8%?**B2. Net Present Value**A project requires an initial outlay of ₱100,000 and generates ₱40,000 per year for 4 years. The cost of capital is 10%. Compute the NPV and decide whether to accept.**B3. Loan Amortization**A ₱200,000 loan is repaid in 5 equal annual installments at 6% annual interest. Compute the annual payment.## C. ECONOMICS PROBLEMS**C1. Price Elasticity of Demand**When price falls from ₱10 to ₱8, quantity demanded rises from 100 to 140 units. Compute the midpoint (arc) price elasticity of demand and classify it.**C2. Profit Maximization / Break-Even**Total cost is TC = 500 + 20Q and the market price is ₱30. (a) What is the break-even quantity? (b) What is profit at Q = 100?**C3. Market Equilibrium**Demand: Qd = 100 − 2P. Supply: Qs = 20 + 2P. Find the equilibrium price and quantity.## D. OTHER BUSINESS ASPECTS**D1. Marketing — Campaign ROI**A campaign costs ₱20,000 and generates ₱80,000 in revenue at a 30% gross margin. Compute the gross profit, net gain, and ROI.**D2. Operations — EOQ**Annual demand is 10,000 units, ordering cost is ₱50 per order, and holding cost is ₱4 per unit per year. Compute the Economic Order Quantity.**D3. Human Resources — Turnover Cost**A company with an average of 100 employees had 20 separations. Average salary is ₱40,000 and replacement cost is 50% of salary. Compute the turnover rate and total turnover cost.**D4. Decision Analysis — Expected Value**Project A: 30% chance of ₱50,000, 50% chance of ₱20,000, 20% chance of −₱10,000.Project B: 30% chance of ₱80,000, 50% chance of ₱10,000, 20% chance of −₱20,000.Compute the expected value of each and recommend one.**D5. Supply Chain — Reorder Point**Daily demand is 200 units, lead time is 7 days, and safety stock is 500 units. Compute the reorder point.**D6. Entrepreneurship — Break-Even**Fixed costs are ₱60,000, selling price is ₱25, and variable cost is ₱15 per unit. Compute the break-even quantity and break-even revenue.---# ANSWER KEY**A1.** Assets = 50,000 + 30,000 + 5,000 + 100,000 − 20,000 = **₱165,000**. Liabilities = 15,000 + 40,000 = **₱55,000**. Equity = **₱110,000**.**A2.** (a) (120,000 − 20,000) ÷ 5 = **₱20,000/yr**. (b) Rate = 40%. Year 1 = 120,000 × 0.40 = **₱48,000**; Year 2 = (120,000 − 48,000) × 0.40 = **₱28,800**.**A3.** +8,000 − 3,000 − 1,200 = **+₱3,800 increase** in net income.**B1.** 50,000 ÷ 1.08⁵ = 50,000 ÷ 1.46933 = **₱34,029.10**.**B2.** PV of annuity = 40,000 × 3.16987 = ₱126,794.60. NPV = 126,794.60 − 100,000 = **₱26,794.60 → accept**.**B3.** Payment = 200,000 × [0.06 ÷ (1 − 1.06⁻⁵)] = **₱47,479.28**.**C1.** %ΔQ = 40 ÷ 120 = 33.33%; %ΔP = −2 ÷ 9 = −22.22%. Elasticity = 33.33 ÷ 22.22 = **1.5 → elastic**.**C2.** (a) 30Q = 500 + 20Q → Q = **50 units**. (b) TR = 3,000; TC = 500 + 2,000 = 2,500; Profit = **₱500**.**C3.** 100 − 2P = 20 + 2P → P = **₱20**; Q = **60 units**.**D1.** Gross profit = 80,000 × 0.30 = ₱24,000. Net gain = 24,000 − 20,000 = ₱4,000. ROI = 4,000 ÷ 20,000 = **20%**.**D2.** EOQ = √(2 × 10,000 × 50 ÷ 4) = √250,000 = **500 units**.**D3.** Turnover rate = 20 ÷ 100 = **20%**. Cost per separation = 40,000 × 0.50 = ₱20,000. Total = 20 × 20,000 = **₱400,000**.**D4.** A = 15,000 + 10,000 − 2,000 = **₱23,000**. B = 24,000 + 5,000 − 4,000 = **₱25,000 → choose Project B**.**D5.** ROP = (200 × 7) + 500 = **1,900 units**.**D6.** CM = 25 − 15 = ₱10. BE quantity = 60,000 ÷ 10 = **6,000 units**. BE revenue = **₱150,000**.---**To make your zip:** paste everything above into Notepad and save as `business_problems.txt`, or into Word and save as `.docx`, then right-click the file → "Send to → Compressed (zipped) folder." Want me to expand any section (e.g., more problems per topic, or a version without the answer key)?
